what: Gumroad help center states that Gumroad enables creators in more than 160 countries to accept payments. Sellers are paid via direct bank deposits or PayPal depending on country. Those outside direct-deposit countries must have a verified PayPal account.
verbatim_snippet: "Gumroad enables creators in more than 160 countries to accept payments from their customers. Based on the country you're in, you can either get paid via direct bank deposits, or PayPal. If you live (and have proof that you live) in one of the following countries, you are paid out to your bank account, and in some cases, a debit card. If you live outside of the these countries, you must have a PayPal account, and your account must be verified by PayPal to sell goods on Gumroad. There is no way around this, unfortunately."
notes: Page requires login. Snippet recovered from search engine index tied to this specific URL. The page contains a table of direct-deposit countries that was not fully captured by search index.
